messages.subject: destrend
parts:
We carried out RRBS with the Diagenode kit. We ran SE 50bp sequencing and used Trim Galore ( --rrbs and —non_directional) and Bismark prior Methylkit. We have identified CpG DMSs between two groups of 6 samples using the overdispersion chi2 method. We have also used destrand=TRUE setting. At the end we realized that more than 10% of our DMSs are at 50 bp physical distance from each other. When switching the destrand to FALSE the number of DMS was divided by 2 and the 50bp distance peak at the DMS distance distribution disappeared. 
1/ What is the reason of our observation? Is this a complete artefact?
2/ Do we have to use therefore the destrand=FALSE setting or can we extract some real positives from the TRUE analysis what we wouldn’t identify with the FALSE?

Thanks for your help,
Tamas

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] destrend
parts: Check fastqc and Bismark stats more carefully after trimming, maybe you need to trim more, there could be artifacts at the ends of the reads,  check m-bias plots
